Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: Misclassified opéra-comique as not being opera and concluded Ambroise Thomas was not an opera composer, despite the cited Britannica snippet stating he was best known for his operas (e.g., Mignon, Hamlet). Opéra-comique is a subgenre of opera, so both Verdi and Thomas are opera composers.
